teamNotes: The ARC-AGI-3 entry is a four-account team, so its standing belongs to the team and is never credited as Grigoriy Zatravkin's individual honour. Kaggle's competition card showed four team-member pictures, which agrees with the four accounts on the public board.

The board shows the team name as 'Grigoriy Zatravkin & co'. Its team id is 16490178, and the board's own movement log names the team 'Grigoriy Zatravkin' on 16, 17 and 19 October, with the team's rank moving from 10th to 7th to 6th as scores rose to 47.19. Those are provisional public positions.
